QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Wind
QuestInfo.0: Following what the Empress said, go see #bChief Knight Irena#k before leaving Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: To use Irena's Wind Piercing, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Wind. Get it from #r#o4230201##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've learned Irena's Wind Piercing skill. Use Unstoppable Wind every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1 until Lv. 90.

0.0: How are you? I'm the Chief Knight of Wind, Irena.\r\nI feel...a strong wind stirring within you, #h0#. Yes, your latent powers should allow you to use Wind Piercing. Are you interested to find out?

yes.0: All right! To make the wind that can dissipate the dark clouds, you need Unstoppable Winds. They are very rare, you know...
yes.1: Only the Unstoppable Wind can condense the power of the Spirit of Wind into an arrow. Please obtain #b10 #t4032873#s#k from #r#o4230201#s#k.

1.0: I feel the surging winds. Please give them to me.

yes.0: Check the Beginner's Basics tab by opening your Skill Inventory. Call me whenever you need me, and I will skewer your foes with the Spirit of Wind.
yes.1: And don't forget that you can come every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1 until Lv. 90.

item.0: You can't learn Wind Piercing without #b10 #t4032873#s#k, which can be obtained from #r#o4230201##k monsters.
